title: Midtown Manhattan Skyline with Chrysler Building, 1956 NYC B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Manhattan, New York City, New York, United States
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing the midtown Manhattan skyline in New York City, highlighted by the iconic Art Deco spire of the Chrysler Building framed by surrounding high-rises and mid-century architecture. The top margin features a processing date stamp of June 1956 on deckled-edge photo paper, reflecting the post-war urban growth and timeless architectural density of mid-century New York.
